description: This file defines a console command class 'ToolkitCommand' for the Goteo project. It provides various database integrity check and repair tools for projects, investments, pools, and posts, accessible via command-line interface. The class contains configuration and execution methods that implement multiple maintenance and correction routines based on specified scope or options.

classes.name: ToolkitCommand
classes.description: A console command class providing tools to check and repair database issues for projects, investments, pools, and blog comments, with capabilities for verification and optional automatic fixing based on command options.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, arguments, options, and help text for the toolkit command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the database integrity checks and repairs based on the input scope and options. Implements multiple routines for projects, investments, pools, and posts, with output to the console and optional fixes when '--update' is specified.
